name: Sim Love ~Hitonatsu no Kiseki~
source:
Masami’s father gets remarried, and they move to a town in the country. His new mother has a daughter, Shino. One day, he receives a mobile phone mail from a girl named Megu. Though he doesn’t know her, he replies to it.

“Sorry, who are you?”

“Ah, I'm sorry.”

“I’m surprised. I’ve just moved to this town.”

“From where?”

“From Tokyo.”

“Oh, you’re a city boy.”

They become friends, and he gradually…

[Edited from ErogeShop]
